_about: C-23: offsets into SaveBlock2 (section 0) and SaveBlock1 (sections 1-4, end to end), read from global.h's own struct comments; flag numbers resolved from flags.h. A flag below daemons_flags_start is a bit in SaveBlock1's flags, one at or above it a bit in SaveBlock2's daemonsFlags. INDEX flags are by national number minus one. Money is stored XOR the encryption key. A daemon is SEEN only when sb2 index_seen and sb1 seen1 and seen2 all have its bit (pokedex_screen.c's anticheat), so a writer sets all three. T-427: house_take is the house's take (what the GAME CORNER and the CASINO kept, in money), house_take_bytes wide, signed little-endian (negative while the player is ahead), stored plain -- NOT XORed as money is. Only ever added to. house_take_at_fall is the take as it stood when CORPUS fell (the game freezes it there, once; VERDIGRIS names it), same width and sign -- the game's to write, never a writer's. T-406: sb1 first_met is where each daemon was first SEEN, first_met_bytes bytes, one per national number (number - 1), each a map section first_met_places names (0: not recorded); trust them only when the u32 at first_met_magic is first_met_magic_value (an older save holds a recap scene there). A SEEN daemon with 0 was seen before the game kept them: the INDEX says BEFORE RECORDS.

reads._about: C-203: THE LOG's vars, each u16 at sb1 vars + (var - vars_start) * 2. where: newest first, log of them -- the map section in the low byte (first_met_places names it; 0: an empty row, the log ends), the phrase at phrase_shift (phrase_mask wide), landed at landed_bit. thing: the flag that says that read's thing was found, 0 for a read about nothing; a read whose flag is set has landed even before the game marks it (the game marks it, and counts it, on the next arrival or when the page is opened). Lines: reads and leans with {1} {2}, then each read '<place><colon><phrase>' and landed after it when it has.

its_dreams._about: T-462 / C-200: ITS DREAMS. Each var is a u16 (little-endian) in SaveBlock1 at the sb1 offset given (vars + (var - vars_start) * 2). The COMPANION writes the four under 'write' at a SYNC that brings a new dream and leaves them as they are when there is none: dream = quality (1 broken, 2 quiet, 3 vivid) | 4 if tucked in | image << 8; hours in tenths; nights = nights since the last SYNC | rested nights << 8 (each capped 255); day = days since 2026-01-01. The GAME treats a day it has not filed as a new dream and files it at the first dawn after it sees it (or on the first load on a later day). The rest is the game's and never written by a writer: filed = the day + 1 of the last dream filed (0 none); kinds / kinds_2 = the quality last filed for images 0-7 / 8-15, two bits each, image 0 lowest (0 never filed); and image n is filed when DAEMONS flag filed_flag_first + n is set (a bit in sb2 daemons_flags, as profile_layout explains). titles: each image's title in the NOTEBOOK, in image order.
